reading_rule: Complete selected scientific source values, with custody-only fields removed as documented. Author-state tokens remain dated source history; original later qualification governs scientific acceptance.

source_record.review_mode: Exposed development cases; not independent or held out

cases.proposition: A WIP limit can relocate a queue without reducing total lead time.
cases.ceiling: Finite deterministic construction; no switching, quality or worker effects. Not a Little law proof or a field replication.
cases.counter_control: A single arriving job has local and total lead time 1 under either rule. An admission cap may still protect active commitments.

cases.proposition: Full utilization alone does not determine waiting; arrival variability matters.
cases.ceiling: Finite traces, not stationary stochastic queue results. Does not establish a universal optimum or the safety of sustained human loading.
cases.counter_control: The stable trace defeats a universal claim that maximum utilization always creates a queue; the burst trace defeats equivalence of utilization and service quality.

cases.proposition: Batch size trades setup cost against feedback; minimum size is not universally best.
cases.ceiling: Serial nonoverlapping batch model; transport, rework and inventory costs omitted. No recommendation for a real process.
cases.counter_control: With zero setup both batches have equal completion time and batch one provides earlier feedback. Setup reduction can change the trade-off.

cases.proposition: The same positive signal can warrant different containment under different consequences.

inputs.model_assumption: Stop eliminates the modelled loss; expected costs are commensurable

cases.ceiling: Hypothetical expected-loss model. Legal/safety constraints, uncertainty, authority and unmodelled harms are separate premises; this calculation authorizes no action.
cases.counter_control: An infallible safe interlock may be simpler. A noisy alarm without a responder is not containment; indiscriminate global stopping is not justified by detection alone.

cases.proposition: A valid buyer saving can coexist with increased system cost.
cases.ceiling: Constructed commensurable costs; worker rights and other nontradable constraints must still be checked separately.
cases.counter_control: The alternative preserves a buyer saving and reduces total cost. The counterexample rejects automatic inference from focal savings, not all inventory reduction or supplier coordination.

cases.proposition: Signal counts do not establish response, decision rights or protection.

inputs.model: Four distinct qualitative premises, with missing evidence represented by None

cases.ceiling: Author-defined logical separation, not a measurement of human experience or a historical Boolean predicate.
cases.counter_control: A small team with demonstrated bounded authority can satisfy the model without a formal suggestion programme. A statement of rights is not evidence of their realization.

cases.proposition: Useful standardization permits legitimate exceptions and changed-condition review.
cases.ceiling: Constructed decision model; explicit expiry is an analytical safeguard, not a historical TPS universal.
cases.counter_control: The stable applicable case requires no rewrite; the authorized exception defeats immutable compliance without permitting arbitrary unsafe deviation.

cases.proposition: Option intersection can avert premature commitment but does not require endless parallelism.
cases.ceiling: Finite fully known design sets; learning cost, deadlines and real feasibility uncertainty remain open.
cases.counter_control: If both disciplines already accept only a, early commitment is adequate. The result is subsumed by EL-029/EL-030 and does not earn a new property identity.

cases.proposition: An accessible citation URL is not evidence of source identity.
cases.ceiling: Regression against author-inspected document identities; does not re-fetch the web or prove any downstream supply-chain proposition.
cases.counter_control: R009 matches the intended topic, but its proposal still is not causal resilience evidence. Full bibliography closure cannot be inferred from this one repaired citation.

cases.proposition: Exposure and estimand must match before a study can support a Lean outcome claim.

observed.supported_conclusion: This study cannot directly establish a Lean mortality null

cases.ceiling: Source-comparison regression, not a reanalysis of patient data and not invalidation of every review result.
cases.counter_control: R006 actually evaluates a Lean programme, but nonrandom assignment and co-interventions still limit causal attribution. Correct exposure does not itself guarantee causality.

cases.proposition: A cheap existing mechanism or no change can satisfy a bounded need.

inputs.existing_rule: Finish before starting the next item

cases.ceiling: Illustrative decision economics assumes stated effectiveness; no empirical benefit of a specific control is established.
cases.counter_control: Natural boundedness needs no board to create the bound. The higher-consequence case shows why the cheap-path result does not justify omission everywhere.

cases.proposition: Individually useful controls can be jointly uneconomic when their benefits overlap.
cases.ceiling: Constructed overlap model, not an estimate of real Lean control overhead.
cases.counter_control: With distinct independent benefits totalling 10, the pair has net benefit 4. Composition must establish overlap or distinctness rather than assume either.

cases.proposition: An enforced smaller deployment can reduce directly exposed independent instances without qualification or recovery.

inputs.origin: Reviewer RV01, reproduced by the author for r2
inputs.exposure_measure: Number of independent instances receiving the same faulty change

cases.ceiling: Finite reviewer counterexample reproduced, not independently authored or a field trial. It refutes the former necessary-bundle clause for this count; duration, severity, value, total cost and authority are not established.
cases.counter_control: If a single changed instance corrupts shared state used by all 100, the isolation guard fails and all 100 can be affected. A smaller nominal scope alone does not guarantee this exposure reduction.

cases.proposition: Scoped qualification and functioning recovery can add benefits beyond a bounded exposure count.

inputs.criterion_scope: These two stipulated operational limits and known qualification fixtures only

cases.ceiling: Constructed positive configuration at explicit limits. Qualification is incomplete by construction; recovery is stipulated to work for this mode. No universal adequacy, authorization, real-system effectiveness or net economic benefit follows.
cases.counter_control: The escaped-fault branch defeats qualification-as-guarantee; failed restoration breaches the duration limit despite the one-instance bound. A known rejected fault demonstrates prevention, while C13 independently preserves partial exposure reduction without either control.
